caption_en:
Easy to judge from up here. 🐎

The accusations: Gaza's Health Ministry (run by HAMAS) counts 74,645 dead (10 Nov 2026), no civilian/fighter split. UN Satellite Centre (UNOSAT): 81% of structures damaged. UN OCHA: record settler attacks in 2026.

Governments that turned on people they ruled:
France, Algeria, 1954 to 1962: 350,000 dead (French est.) to 1.5M (FLN, National Liberation Front).
Assad's Syria: 306,887 civilians killed by all sides, 2011 to 2021 (UN OHCHR, 2022); up to 617,910 dead in all (SOHR, 2024). UN inquiry: deliberate starvation (2018), deliberate strikes on medical facilities (2020). 6,786 died in custody (HRW, 2015).
Britain, Kenya: 11,000+ killed officially; likely 20,000+ (historian David Anderson); 1,090 hanged.
Iran's regime, Jan 2026: 7,007 confirmed dead in 50 days (HRANA); 30,000+ reported (Time, citing health officials). 1,639 hanged in 2025 (Iran Human Rights).

Pace, our math: Iran 981 a week vs Gaza war 462 a week. At Iran's pace, the same 1,130 days would mean about 158,000 (hypothetical).

Israel, attacked on 7 Oct 2023, warned: 7.2M leaflets, 13.7M texts, 15M calls (IDF, Jan 2024); daily evacuation corridor (UN OCHA, Nov 2023); 1.78M tons of food in, Oct 2025 to Jun 2026 (COGAT). Critics say warnings weren't enough. Fighters among the dead: disputed.

Israel is far from perfect, but not the outlier it's painted as. Every death in Gaza is a tragedy.

Photos: Abedallah Alhaj; Touring Club Italiano; Ortho; Jerome KL; J. J. Badwan (CC BY-SA); IranAzadShod (CC0); via Wikimedia Commons. AI voice.
Send this to someone on a high horse.
caption_he:
קל לשפוט מלמעלה.
צרפת באלג'יריה: עד 1.5 מיליון הרוגים. סוריה של אסד: מעל 300 אלף אזרחים. בריטניה בקניה: מעל 11 אלף. איראן, ינואר 2026: 7,007 הרוגים מאומתים ב־50 יום, ודיווחים על 30 אלף.
ישראל הותקפה, והזהירה לפני שתקפה. רחוקה משלמות, אבל לא החריגה. כל מוות בעזה הוא טרגדיה.
אז רדו מהסוס הגבוה.

If I were Israel, I'd have done it differently.
Now let's climb down, to governments that turned on people they ruled.

In Assad's Syria: over three hundred thousand civilians killed.
Britain, in Kenya: over eleven thousand killed.
Iran, January twenty twenty-six: seven thousand confirmed dead. Up to thirty thousand reported.
That's about a thousand a week. Gaza's war: about four hundred sixty.
At that pace, the same three years: over a hundred fifty thousand.
Israel, attacked on October seventh, warned before striking.
Seven point two million leaflets, thirteen point seven million texts, fifteen million calls.
One side aims at people. The other warns them to leave.
Israel is far from perfect. But it's not the outlier it's painted as.
Every death in Gaza is a tragedy.
So get off your high horse.
